contracts.name: HOLY-BOOK / WISDOM SOURCE INTERPRETER
method: lock exact source text and source location
extract explicit source claims without interpretation
separate actors/events/rules/promises/consequences
reconstruct source-local Sequence only where supported
create interpretation records separately
label unknowns, contradictions and translation differences
return WisdomCandidate only with source links and applicability questions
contracts.closure_condition: All extracted claims are source-linked and interpretation boundaries are explicit for the requested scope.
contracts.acceptance_condition: Requested source evidence or a terminal unknown/contradiction state is returned without manufactured provenance.
closure_responsibilities: Never promote interpretation to source fact; preserve source, translation and provenance boundaries.

contracts.name: WISDOM / PRINCIPLE SYNTHESIS
method: compare multiple closed cases
separate causal patterns from simple temporal repetition
extract repeated relations and long-horizon consequences
find counter-cases and failed generalizations
state applicability and non-applicability conditions
preserve source and interpretation references
create compressed principle only after falsifier pass
contracts.closure_condition: Candidate principle has explicit support, counter-cases, scope and epistemic status.
contracts.acceptance_condition: WisdomObject is context-bounded and source-linked, or synthesis closes as insufficient/contradictory.
closure_responsibilities: Never call one case universal; preserve counter-cases and applicability boundaries.
forbidden: one case treated as universal law

contracts.name: AI RUBRIC / COGNITIVE MECHANISM ROUTER
method: identify the artificial cognition function required
select one or more AI rubric segments
decompose broad capability into implementable mechanisms
declare inputs, memory reads, resources and performer
open Attached Sequence if required mechanism/dependency is missing
execute native mechanism or return unavailable
send structured result to verification before durable write-back
contracts.closure_condition: Required cognition request has a structured result or explicit terminal unavailable/unknown status.
contracts.acceptance_condition: Result satisfies the requesting Sequence contract and has passed required verification.
closure_responsibilities: Route to Sourceborn-native AI mechanisms only; do not hide an LLM/runtime dependency inside the method.
forbidden: next-token generation treated as universal cognition
hidden untracked state used as source truth

contracts.name: ASI RUBRIC / META-GOVERNOR
method: identify cross-domain conflict or governance need
preserve ownership/source boundaries for each input
evaluate rule, authority, permission, priority and long-horizon effects
check Actor View restrictions
check Barrier Law and closure scope
issue governance constraints, block state, unresolved state or new Sequence request
record decision provenance and accountability
contracts.closure_condition: Governance question has a terminal explicit state for the declared scope.
contracts.acceptance_condition: Decision obeys provenance, barrier, actor-view and closure-scope invariants.
closure_responsibilities: Govern without inventing source truth, bypassing barriers, reopening closed Sequences, or collapsing local and global closure.
forbidden: local closure promoted to global closure without evidence
